schema.title: Practice Manager message approval
schema.description: The Practice Manager Agent has drafted a patient-facing message (for example a reschedule offer after a cancellation). Nothing is sent until this is approved.

questions.label: What should happen with this draft?
Edited message
questions.helpText: Only used when you chose "Edit and send" above. Replaces the drafted message body. For a reschedule offer, keep the numbered times as they are.
